title: Case
description: An assistance case opened after a home visit.

urgency.description: LOW: Help can wait for the next regular visit; MEDIUM: Help is needed within a week; HIGH: Risk to safety or basic needs within 48 hours.

riskFlags.description: DISCONNECTION: Power, gas or water is about to be, or has been, cut off; EVICTION: The household has been told to leave its home; NO_FOOD: There is no food in the house today. Food running low is a FOOD need, not this risk; SAFETY: Someone in the household is unsafe at home.

visitDate.description: The day of the home visit.

visitSummary.description: A short, neutral summary of the visit, without names.

visitingMemberRef.description: Id of the Member in the client system

Household.title: Household
Household.description: The people living at one address who asked for help.

contact.description: Phone number or other contact detail.

consentGiven.description: Whether the household agreed to share its details for referrals.

Need.title: Need
Need.description: Something the household needs help with.

category.description: FOOD: Food parcels or supermarket vouchers; ENERGY_BILL: Help with gas or electricity bills, including disconnection notices; RENT: Help with rent arrears or bond.

details.description: What the notes say about this need, in one sentence.

Assistance.title: Assistance
Assistance.description: Help Vinnies gives directly, such as vouchers or paying part of a bill.

category.description: FOOD: Food parcels or supermarket vouchers; ENERGY_BILL: Help with gas or electricity bills, including disconnection notices; RENT: Help with rent arrears or bond.

Referral.title: Referral
Referral.description: Sending the household to another service for help Vinnies does not give.

serviceRef.description: Id of the Service in the client system
